info.title: bv
info.description: A .NET global CLI tool that helps implement better development workflows, both locally and in CI.

options.name: --configuration
options.description:
MSBuild configuration to build. Defaults
to the configured value, or 'Release'

options.name: --bump
options.description:
Version-spec change to apply:
- none (the default): advance patch
from Git height.
- unstable: advance patch, add
prerelease label.
- stable: advance patch, drop
- minor: advance minor, reset patch,
add prerelease label.
- major: advance major, reset minor and
patch, add prerelease label

options.name: --check-public-api
options.description:
Check the public API when computing
version-spec changes. Defaults to true

options.name: --dogfood
options.description:
Update in-tree references to packages
produced by this release. Defaults to
true

options.name: --allow-unknown-host
options.description:
Tag and push on an unknown Git host,
without a release page. Defaults to false

commands.name: self-update
commands.description:
Update the repository's Buildvana pins (tool manifest,
global.json, package pins, app directives,
configuration schema reference) to a single version:
the latest version on the package sources, or the one
--preview, --repair, or --to picks. Unlike a canonical
self-update, it changes the repository, never this
binary

options.name: --force
options.description:
Update the repository's pins even when they are newer
than the target version (downgrade)

options.name: --preview
options.description:
Update to the latest version on the package sources,
prereleases included

options.name: --repair
options.description:
Update the repository to the bv version the tool
manifest pins, without asking the package sources

options.name: --to
options.description:
Update the repository to this version, without asking
the package sources
